brief: A kitchen garden terrace by a sunny back door: three rows of four planters stepping up one, two and three storeys from front to back, so no row shades the row in front of it. Back row, full-size greens: kale, romaine, chard and bok choy. Middle row, herbs: basil, parsley, mint and chives. Front row: strawberries in two planters, a nasturtium and a marigold. Fill every planter with soil and plant it.

finish.summary: Built a 4x3 stepped terrace: front row single-storey, middle two-storey, back three-storey, each cell a soil-filled full planter with the requested harvest-stage planting in the brief's row order. From above all 12 plantings read; from the default view the tall romaine hides one strawberry and the parsley, so that row reads partial.

lines.label: Edge cap · female, two stories tall
Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
